title: Spanish-Style Iberico Pork Tapas
description: A simple and flavorful tapas dish featuring tender Iberico pork, crispy jamon, and a hint of Spanish flair.

ingredients.name: Iberico Pork Belly
ingredients.notes: Cured Iberico pork belly, preferably acorn-fed

ingredients.name: Spanish Smoked Paprika
ingredients.notes: Smoked paprika adds a deep, smoky flavor

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Flaky sea salt for added texture

instructions: Season the Iberico pork belly with salt and Spanish smoked paprika.
Heat the quaint olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the pork belly until browned on both sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until the pork is tender and slightly caramelized.
Meanwhile, toast the jamon slices in a dry skillet until crispy.
Slice the cooked pork into thin strips and serve with crispy jamon, garlic, and a sprinkle of salt.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
